name: TeamStarWolf - The Year 2017 in Intrusions
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. ATT&CK Enterprise techniques that the verified 2017 record supports: WannaCry (S0366), NotPetya (S0368) and Bad Rabbit (S0606) as ATT&CK records them, campaign C0030, US-CERT alerts TA17-117A, TA17-132A, TA17-181A and TA17-293A, TA18-074A, and behavior described by Talos, ESET, Kaspersky, GAO, the FTC and DOJ for M.E.Doc, NetSarang, CCleaner, Equifax and Uber. Revoked ids are shown under their v20.0 successors from data/attack/superseded_by.jsonl. Each comment names source numbers from case-studies/CHRONICLE_2017.md. Scores: 100 the source or the ATT&CK object prints the id, 70 the source describes the behavior and the study assigns the id, 50 only a Reported source supports the behavior, 40 the mapping is Inferred.
